column1: # The behaviour this set exists for: a person opens a thought out loud and
# never finishes it. Speak It must not manufacture an action from the half
# they did say, and must not treat every short sentence as a fragment.
# Written from the product contract before reading any detector, and
# deliberately adversarial in the false-positive direction: two thirds of it is
# things that look like fragments and are not. A detector that flags everything
# scores worse here than one that flags nothing.
# Columns: id, utterance, family, expectation, note
#   Incomplete  a frame was opened and its required content never arrived.
#               Keep the words, flag for recovery, schedule nothing.
#   Complete    a finished thought. Must NOT be called unfinished, whatever
#   Abandoned   the speaker explicitly withdrew it out loud.
#   Mixed       one finished thought and one unfinished one in one capture.
# --- Dangling infinitive: "to" with no verb after it -------------------------
